sessionCookie.name: nv.session_token
sessionCookie.description: Session cookie set at sign-in. In Postman, sign in once and reuse the cookie jar.

issues.description: Only on 400: which fields are invalid.

post.description: Closed by default: returns 403 with code `signup_closed` unless `ALLOW_SIGNUP=true` or the request carries a valid invite token for the same email in the `x-invite-token` header. The account starts unverified and no session is created (`token` is null): a verification link is emailed and sign-in answers 403 `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` until it is used. An email that already has an account answers exactly like a new one (and the owner is told by email), so nothing reveals which accounts exist. Passwords: at least 12 characters (`PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT`), not a common one (`PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON`), not based on the email (`PASSWORD_BASED_ON_EMAIL`) and not in a known breach (`PASSWORD_BREACHED`), all 400. Limited to 5 / 15 min per IP and per email (429 with `Retry-After`).

200.description: Account created (or the same answer for an existing email); no session yet

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: An account whose email is not confirmed answers 403 with code `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (after the right password) and a new verification link is sent.

Set-Cookie.description: Session cookie `nv.session_token`: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, Max-Age 30 days (sliding, renewed daily).

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)
Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

get.description: Returns `null` when there is no valid session cookie.

200.description: The session and its user, or null

post.summary: Change the password of the signed-in user
post.description: A wrong current password answers 400. The new password follows the same rules as sign-up, all 400: `PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT`, `PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON`, `PASSWORD_BASED_ON_EMAIL` (contains the email of the account) and `PASSWORD_BREACHED`. Limited to 5 / 15 min per user (wrong attempts count). Send `revokeOtherSessions: true` to end every other session; the response then sets a new cookie for this browser. A "password changed" notice is emailed.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

post.summary: Ask for a password reset link by email
post.description: Always answers 200 with the same body, whether or not the account exists (no account enumeration); the email is sent in the background. The link opens `/recuperar/{token}`: single use, valid for 1 hour, the token is stored hashed. Limited to 5 requests / 15 min per IP and per email (429 with `Retry-After`).

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

post.summary: Set a new password with the token of the emailed link
post.description: Uses the token up. On success every session of the user is revoked and a "password changed" notice is emailed. A used, expired or unknown token answers 400. The new password follows the same rules as sign-up, all 400: `PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT`, `PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON`, `PASSWORD_BASED_ON_EMAIL` (contains the email of the token owner) and `PASSWORD_BREACHED`; a rejected password does not use the token up. Limited like the request.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

post.summary: Send (or resend) the email verification link
post.description: Same neutral answer whether or not the address belongs to an unverified account. The link opens `/verificar/{token}` and is valid for 24 hours. Limited to 5 / 15 min per IP and per email, apart from the reset limit. The email itself is sent at most once a minute and ten times an hour per address (shared with sign-up and sign-in); over that the answer is the same but nothing is sent.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

get.summary: Mark the email of the token as verified
get.description: Used by the `/verificar/{token}` page. A bad, forged or expired token answers 401.
No authentication and no data: only tells that the web process is running.
Every member of the pool is listed (their holders are created on demand), then the people added by hand, oldest first. Any member may list. `member` is true while the linked person is still a member.

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.description: Needs `accounts.write`. Aliases are stored upper case without accents (at most 10, 3–60 characters each). Without a `color` the next unused colour of the series palette is used. `userId` links the person to a member of this pool (400 for anybody else); a member is at most one person (409). The body is strict: `poolId`, `id` or any other field answers 400.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

patch.description: Needs `accounts.write`. Fields left out stay; `userId: null` unlinks the member. A holder of another pool answers 404.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

delete.description: Needs `accounts.write`. Answers 409 for a current member of the pool and while accounts or sub-accounts still name the person.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

get.description: Invites that were neither accepted nor cancelled, newest first; expired ones are listed too so they can be resent. Needs `members.invite` (owner, admin).

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.summary: Invite somebody to a pool by email
post.description: Sends a pt-PT email with a single-use link (`/convite/{token}`) valid for 7 days. The role cannot be above the inviter’s own (an admin cannot invite an owner: 403). Inviting an address that already has a pending invite replaces it (the old link stops working); an address that is already a member answers 409. 20 invites a day per pool (429). Unknown fields (`poolId`, `id`, `invitedBy`…) answer 400.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

delete.description: Its link stops working. The id of an invite of another pool, an accepted one, an unknown or a malformed one answers 404. An admin cannot cancel an invite for an owner (403).

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.description: Creates a new link with a new 7-day expiry and emails it; the previous link stops working. Counts towards the 20 invites a day per pool. No body.

200.description: The invite with its new expiry

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.description: The signed-in user joins the pool with the invited role. The session’s email must be verified and equal the invite’s address. An unknown, expired or used token, another account’s invite and an unverified address all answer the same 404, so nothing is confirmed about a token. Single use: the membership and `accepted_at` are written in one transaction. No body.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

get.summary: The signed-in user and their pools
get.description: Pools are listed most recently active first, each with the caller’s role.

patch.summary: Change the name of the signed-in user
patch.description: Only `name` can change (1-120 characters). To change the email use `POST /api/v1/auth/change-email`: the new address receives a link and the email changes only once it is used.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

get.summary: Active sessions of the signed-in user
get.description: Browser and system come from the user agent, the address is masked (`85.240.x.x`). `lastActiveAt` is renewed at most once a day while the session is used.

delete.summary: End every session except the current one
delete.description: Requires `others=true`; without it the answer is 400.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

delete.summary: End one of the signed-in user’s sessions
delete.description: Its cookie stops working at once. The id of another user’s session, an unknown id and a malformed one all answer 404.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.summary: Ask to change the email of the signed-in user
post.description: A verification link goes to the new address (`/verificar/{token}`); the email changes only once it is used. An address that is already taken answers the same. Limited to 5 / 15 min per user and per address, together with `change-password`.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

get.description: Owners first, then by name. Any member may list; `email` is only filled for callers with `members.manage` (owner, admin) and is `null` for everybody else.

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

patch.description: Needs `members.manage`. Admins cannot change owners or hand out a role above their own (403); nobody changes their own role (403, owners transfer the pool instead); a user who is not a member of the pool answers 404; taking the role from the last owner answers 409. The member’s sessions in this pool end, so their next request uses the new permissions. Making somebody an owner also needs the caller’s `password` (a missing or wrong one answers 400 with an issue on `password`, counts towards the account’s password-attempt limit and is never echoed or logged); for any other role `password` is not read. The body is `{ role, password? }` and nothing else: `poolId`, `userId` or any other field answers 400.

200.description: The member and their new role

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

delete.description: Needs `members.manage`. Admins cannot remove owners (403); removing yourself is `leave` (403); removing the last owner answers 409. The person loses access immediately (their next request gets 404), their sessions in the pool end, and what they created stays in the pool.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.description: Any member may leave. The only owner cannot (409): transfer the pool first. What the person created stays in the pool; coming back needs a new invite. No body.

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.summary: Transfer the pool to another member
post.description: Needs `pool.transfer` (owners). The caller confirms with their password: a wrong one answers 400 with an issue on `password` and counts towards the account’s password-attempt limit (429). The target must be another member (404) who is not an owner yet (409). The caller becomes an admin unless `keepOwnership` is true. The new owner’s sessions in the pool end.

200.description: The caller’s role after the transfer

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

post.description: The name is trimmed and must have 1-60 characters without control characters. The caller becomes the `owner` and the only member. At most 10 pools per owner (409 beyond that). The pool, the membership and the `pool.created` audit entry are written in one transaction. Unknown fields (`role`, `id`, `ownerId`…) answer 400.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

get.description: The defaults (transfer window 3 days, deposit and dividend tax 28 %, EUR, no FX override) while the pool never saved any. Any member may read.

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

patch.description: Needs `settings.write` (owner, admin). Fields left out stay; `fxOverrides` replaces the whole map (`{}` removes every override). Percentages are decimal strings from 0 to 100 with up to 4 decimals; rates are positive decimal strings with up to 8 decimals; EUR has no rate. The body is strict: `poolId` or any other field answers 400.

403.description: Not allowed (permission, or a request from another origin)

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)

get.description: For every known currency: the pool’s own override, else the newest market rate dated on or before `asOf`, else the seed constant. `marketRate` is the rate without the override. Any member may read.

404.description: Not found (also returned to non-members of a pool)
